{{Quote|The problem with Hutt slime is that no matter how hard you rub, the filth just won't come off.|Sal Ransen, at the 343rd Conference of Despotism|<ref name="Xim Week: The Despotica">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/ximweek02/index.html|text=Xim Week: ''The Despotica'' (Part I)|int=Xim Week: The Despotica}}</ref>}}
The '''343rd Conference of Despotism''' was a conference. The historian [[Sal Ransen]] attended it and while there, he claimed that [[Xim/Legends|Xim the Despot]] might not have been the tyrant that he was generally regarded to be and that instead, he may have been a victim of [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] propaganda.<ref name="Xim Week: The Despotica" />
